args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion in the Coastal reports:

- Pellow Home Living (PHL) was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- "PHL" is also the shorthand for Pellucid Harbor Logistics, so filtering "PHL" in the morning report returns both businesses.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows, and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.
- Moss's coverage digest (18 May) says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". That is the old name, and the receiving supervisor ends up searching twice.
- On 17 Feb Sofia said she would relabel the saved retail view and Kwame said he would fix the terminal view. We can't confirm from the digest whether either was done.

Could you confirm the correct account name and label, and help us get the saved report and the "PHL" shorthand cleaned up so the two businesses can be told apart?

Thanks,
Bettina
